text: At a jump discontinuity x0 of a piecewise-smooth function, the Fourier series converges to:
choices: the average of the one-sided limits, (f(x0+) + f(x0-))/2
explanation: Dirichlet's pointwise convergence theorem gives the midpoint of the jump, (f(x0+) + f(x0-))/2, at a discontinuity of a piecewise-smooth function; at points of continuity the series converges to f(x). It does not diverge.
